verdict.rationale: Publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for an IAM product like Keycloak, so the axis applies. Direct probes returned HTTP 404 for https://www.keycloak.org/llms.txt and for a markdown docs endpoint. Nothing else in the pack documents agent-oriented documentation; the conventional HTML guides and REST API docs are not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
